name: image-library-and-display
description: Electron image library and display: index images in place, browse and zoom

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && electron-vite build
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:smoke
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build && NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-sqlite vitest run --project smoke
